mainTopic: The missing יסוד at the southeast corner of the מזבח: the dispute between רב and לוי over what 'no יסוד' means, and the proofs for each side
overview: The גמרא finishes explaining why בנימין merited having the שכינה dwell in his portion. It then challenges the idea that the southeast corner of the מזבח had no יסוד: the כהן did the מליקה of a bird עולה there, so was he working in empty air? רב נחמן בר יצחק answers that the airspace belonged to בנימין while the ground belonged to יהודה. Next the גמרא asks what 'no יסוד' means. רב says no base was built there, and לוי says a base stood there but no blood was put on it. Each view matches how its author translates the פסוק about בנימין. The גמרא then tests both views against sources about the יסוד's length, the 32 by 32 size of the מזבח, and the overhanging ramp, and each proof is pushed away. Finally it quotes לוי's ברייתא on how the מזבח is built as stacked squares, which seems to show a יסוד on every side. It begins a response with 'וכי תימא' that continues on the next amud.

steps.title: בנימין became the host of the הקדוש ברוך הוא
steps.stepSummary: The end of a statement: בנימין longed for the strip of land that went to יהודה, so he merited that the קדוש ברוך הוא would dwell in his portion.
steps.simpleTranslation: "He hovers over it all day." Therefore בנימין the righteous merited to become the host of the קדוש ברוך הוא, as it says: "And He dwells between his shoulders."
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes a teaching that started just before this section. בנימין always longed for that spot, so he was rewarded by having the שכינה dwell in his portion.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Before this, the גמרא explained that a strip of יהודה's land stuck out into בנימין's portion where the מזבח stood, and this pained בנימין. 'חופף עליו כל היום' describes his constant longing for it. Because of that longing, he merited that the holiest place, the dwelling of the שכינה, would be in his portion.

keyTerms.meaning: Hovers over or covers; here, constantly focused on and longing for the spot
A host who welcomes a guest
Dwells (the root of the word שכינה)

phrases.english: "He hovers over it all day."
phrases.notes: דברים 33:12. בנימין is always 'hovering' over that spot, longing for it.

phrases.english: Therefore Binyamin the righteous merited
and became the host of the Holy One, Blessed be He,
as it is said: "And He dwells between his shoulders."

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes a statement begun before this section about the border between יהודה and בנימין.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Because בנימין longed for the place, he merited that the שכינה dwells in his portion.

steps.title: A ברייתא on how the bird burnt offering was done
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes a ברייתא about the מליקה of an עולת העוף, done on the wall of the מזבח, to set up a challenge.
steps.simpleTranslation: They challenged from a ברייתא: How was a bird burnt offering done? The כהן would pinch its head from opposite its nape, sever it, and squeeze its blood out onto the wall of the מזבח.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא as the source for a challenge. This step is setup, and the actual attack comes in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The full ברייתא says the כהן did this at the southeast corner of the מזבח, which is exactly the corner said to have no יסוד. The ברייתא assumes the bird is held over a real part of the מזבח while its blood is squeezed onto the wall.

keyTerms.meaning: Does מליקה: kills the bird by pinching with the thumbnail

phrases.english: They raised an objection:
How was a bird burnt offering done?

phrases.aramaic: הָיָה מוֹלֵק אֶת רֹאשָׁהּ מִמּוּל עוֹרְפָּהּ,
phrases.english: He would pinch its head from opposite its nape,
phrases.notes: The כהן kills the bird with his thumbnail, cutting from the back of the neck.

phrases.english: and sever it,
and squeeze out its blood on the wall of the altar.

steps.triggerLanguage: מיתיבי עולת העוף כיצד היתה נעשית
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Turns from the אגדה about בנימין to challenge the claim that the southeast corner had no יסוד.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that the southeast corner of the מזבח had no יסוד
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Setup: the ברייתא places the bird offering at that corner, so the corner must be a functioning part of the מזבח.

steps.title: Was the כהן working in empty air?
steps.stepSummary: If the corner had no יסוד, the כהן would be doing the מליקה in mere air, outside the מזבח.
steps.simpleTranslation: And if you say that corner had no יסוד, then he is just doing it in empty air!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא now states the actual challenge from the ברייתא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: With no יסוד under that corner, the space where the כהן held the bird would not belong to the מזבח at all. But an offering must be done in the area of the מזבח, so the ברייתא seems to prove that the corner did have a יסוד.

keyTerms.meaning: The base of the מזבח, a ledge at the bottom

phrases.aramaic: וְאִי אָמְרַתְּ לֹא הָיָה לָהּ יְסוֹד –
phrases.english: And if you say it had no base,
he is merely doing it in the air!

steps.triggerLanguage: ואי אמרת לא היה לה יסוד
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Draws the challenge out of the ברייתא quoted in step 2.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that the southeast corner had no יסוד
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A corner with no יסוד means the bird was offered in empty air, outside the area of the מזבח, which cannot be right.

steps.title: Air to בנימין, ground to יהודה
steps.stepSummary: רב נחמן בר יצחק answers that the tribes made a condition: the airspace there belongs to בנימין and the ground belongs to יהודה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב נחמן בר יצחק said: Say they made this condition: the airspace belongs to בנימין, and the ground belongs to יהודה.
steps.whatsHappening: רב נחמן בר יצחק answers the challenge by splitting ownership of that spot between the two tribes.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ground at that corner was יהודה's, so no יסוד was built on it. But the air above it was given to בנימין, so it counts as part of the מזבח's area. That means the מליקה done up in the air is valid.

keyTerms.meaning: They made a condition (when the land was divided)

steps.whatToRemember: The corner has no יסוד because its ground is יהודה's, yet offerings above it are valid because its air is בנימין's.

phrases.english: Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said:
Say that they made this condition:
the airspace is Binyamin's,
the ground is Yehudah's.

steps.triggerLanguage: אמר רב נחמן בר יצחק אימר כך התנו
steps.terutzResolutionType: Splitting ownership of one location between airspace and ground
steps.terutzHavaAmina: No יסוד means the whole spot is outside the מזבח, so the bird offering there would be in empty air.
steps.terutzMaskana: The ground is יהודה's, so it has no יסוד, but the airspace is בנימין's, so the offering above it is in a valid place.

steps.title: What does 'no יסוד' mean?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what exactly is meant by saying that corner had no יסוד.
steps.simpleTranslation: What does it mean that it had no יסוד?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא opens a new question about the meaning of the phrase 'it had no יסוד'. This sets up the dispute in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Until now we assumed 'no יסוד' means nothing was built there. The גמרא now asks whether that is really the meaning, or whether it means something else.

phrases.english: What does "it had no base" mean?
phrases.notes: Some versions say הֲוָה (in round brackets) and some say הָיָה (in square brackets). Both mean 'was'.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Leaves the challenge and asks what the original phrase means.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The meaning of 'it had no יסוד'

steps.title: רב: no building; לוי: no blood
steps.stepSummary: רב says no יסוד was physically built there. לוי says the base was there, but it was not used for blood.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב said: It means in building. לוי said: It means in blood.
steps.whatsHappening: Two אמוראים give different meanings to 'no יסוד'.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For רב, that corner had no base structure built at all. For לוי, a base physically stood there, but blood that is meant to go on the יסוד was not put on that part.

keyTerms.meaning: In terms of building; it was not physically built
In terms of blood; blood was not placed there

steps.confusionAlert: According to לוי, the base was physically present at that corner. 'No יסוד' only means it did not serve as a יסוד for blood.

phrases.english: Rav said: in building,
Levi said: in blood.

steps.triggerLanguage: רב אמר בבנין לוי אמר בדמים
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: רב: no base was built there. לוי: a base existed, but no blood was placed there.

steps.title: Each one's view matches his translation
steps.stepSummary: רב translates the פסוק about בנימין as 'in his portion the מזבח will be built'. לוי translates it as 'in his portion the מקדש will be built', meaning a place made holy for blood.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב translates: "In his portion the מזבח will be built." לוי translates: "In his portion the מקדש will be built", meaning a place made holy for blood.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא shows that each אמורא's view fits the way he translates the פסוק about בנימין in בראשית.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רב says the מזבח itself is built only in בנימין's portion, so no base was built on יהודה's land. לוי says בנימין's portion is the place made holy for blood. So the base could physically stand on יהודה's land, but blood could not be placed there.
steps.whatToRemember: רב: יהודה's corner had no base built at all. לוי: it had a base, but blood was not placed there, because only בנימין's portion is 'made holy for blood'.

phrases.english: Rav translates: "In his portion the altar will be built,"
phrases.notes: This is רב's Aramaic reading of בראשית 49:27, the ברכה about בנימין.

phrases.english: Levi translates: "In his portion the Sanctuary will be built":
a place sanctified for blood.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Shows that the dispute in step 6 matches each אמורא's translation of the פסוק.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רב ties the מזבח's structure to בנימין's portion. לוי ties the holiness for blood to בנימין's portion.

steps.title: A source that seems to show the base was missing on the south and east
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings a משנה saying the יסוד ran along all of the north and west sides, but 'ate up' only one אמה on the south and one אמה on the east. This sounds like רב: there was no יסוד on most of those sides.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: The base ran along the whole north side and along the whole west side. It 'took up' one cubit on the south and one cubit on the east!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a source that seems to prove רב's view, that most of the south and east sides had no יסוד built at all.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the יסוד covered only one אמה on the south and east sides, then the rest of those sides had no יסוד. That fits רב, who said it was simply not built there. It seems to work against לוי, who said the יסוד was present all around.

keyTerms.meaning: The base at the bottom of the מזבח
Literally 'eats'; here it means it took up or covered a stretch

phrases.english: Come and hear: The base would run
along the whole north side
and along the whole west side.
It 'took up' one cubit on the south
phrases.notes: So on the south and east sides it only went one אמה in from the corner, not the whole way.

phrases.english: and one cubit on the east!

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּא שְׁמַע: הַיְסוֹד הָיָה מְהַלֵּךְ עַל פְּנֵי כׇּל הַצָּפוֹן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts testing the רב/לוי dispute from step 6 against a משנה.
steps.raayaObject: רב's view that the יסוד was not built on most of the south and east sides
steps.raayaSupportSource: משנה in מדות: the יסוד took up only one אמה on the south and the east

steps.title: The word 'took up' is about blood
steps.stepSummary: לוי's side answers that 'אוכל' means the area that took in blood. The יסוד was there all around, but only that stretch was used for blood.
steps.simpleTranslation: What does 'took up' mean? Here too, it is about blood.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes away the proof for רב by reading the word 'אוכל' as being about where the blood went.
steps.deeperAnalysis: According to לוי, the משנה is not measuring where the יסוד was built. It is telling us which part of the יסוד 'took in' blood. So the יסוד can be there on every side, just as לוי said.

phrases.english: What is 'took up'? Here too, it is about blood.
phrases.notes: 'Here too' points back to step 6, where לוי said 'no יסוד' was about blood (בדמים).

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the proof for רב in step 8.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects reading the משנה as a measurement of where the יסוד was built
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: 'אוכל' can mean where the יסוד took in blood, not where it physically existed

steps.title: A source that seems to show the base was 32 by 32
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings a source saying the מזבח was 32 by 32 אמות. That sounds like the bottom, with the יסוד, was full size on every side, which fits לוי.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: The altar was thirty-two by thirty-two!
steps.whatsHappening: Now the גמרא brings a source that seems to prove לוי's view, that the יסוד ran around all four sides.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A full 32 by 32 measurement, the size at the very bottom, sounds like the יסוד went all the way around. That works against רב, who said parts of the south and east had no יסוד.

phrases.english: Come and hear: The altar was
thirty-two by thirty-two!

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּא שְׁמַע: הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הָיָה שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁתַּיִם עַל שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁתַּיִם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Switches sides and brings a proof for לוי.
steps.raayaObject: לוי's view that the יסוד existed on all four sides

steps.title: The 32 is measured only along the sides
steps.stepSummary: רב's side answers that the 32 measurement is 'from the side', meaning only along the north and west sides, where the יסוד ran the whole length.
steps.simpleTranslation: What case are we dealing with here? Measuring from the side.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes away the proof for לוי by limiting what the 32 measurement covers.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רב can say the 32 was measured along the north and west, the sides that had a full יסוד. So the measurement does not prove that the south and east had a full יסוד too.

keyTerms.meaning: What case are we dealing with here? (used to limit a source to a narrower case)

phrases.english: What case are we dealing with here?
From the side.
phrases.notes: He means the 32 is measured along the north and west sides, where the base ran the whole way.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the proof for לוי in step 10.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects reading 32 by 32 as true for all four sides
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The measurement is taken only along the full sides

steps.title: The ramp hung over the base
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא says the top of the ramp hung one אמה over the יסוד and one אמה over the סובב. Since the ramp was on the south side, that suggests a יסוד was there, which fits לוי.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: It turns out it hung one cubit over the base and one cubit over the surrounding ledge!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings another source that seems to prove לוי, that the יסוד was present even on the south side.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ramp was on the south. If it hung over the יסוד there, then there was a יסוד on the south side. That goes against רב.

keyTerms.meaning: Literally 'flying'; hanging out over something in the air
The ledge running around the middle of the מזבח

phrases.english: Come and hear: It turns out it hung out
phrases.notes: This is talking about the top of the ramp, which stuck out in the air.

phrases.english: one cubit over the base
and one cubit over the surrounding ledge!

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּא שְׁמַע: נִמְצָא פּוֹרֵחַ אַמָּה עַל יְסוֹד וְאַמָּה עַל סוֹבֵב
steps.raayaObject: לוי's view that the יסוד was on the south side too
steps.raayaSupportSource: ברייתא: the ramp hung over the יסוד and the סובב

steps.title: Read it as 'facing where the base would be'
steps.stepSummary: רב's side rereads the ברייתא: the ramp hung over the spot where an אמה of יסוד would have been. That does not mean a יסוד was actually there.
steps.simpleTranslation: Say: 'toward' a cubit of base, and over a cubit of the surrounding ledge.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes away the proof for לוי by changing how we read the words of the ברייתא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Instead of 'over the יסוד', רב reads 'opposite the place of the יסוד'. So the ramp hung over empty space where a יסוד would normally be. The סובב part stays the same.

keyTerms.meaning: Say, read it as (used to suggest a different reading)

phrases.english: Say: 'facing' a cubit of base,
phrases.notes: He means facing the spot where the base would be, even though no base was built there.

phrases.english: and over a cubit of the surrounding ledge.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the proof for לוי in step 12.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects the reading that the ramp hung over a real יסוד
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The ברייתא can be read as 'facing' the יסוד's place, not 'over' an actual יסוד

steps.title: לוי's teaching on how the altar was built
steps.stepSummary: לוי teaches a ברייתא: a 32 by 32 frame, one אמה high, is filled with stones and a poured mixture, and 'this is the place of the יסוד'. That suggests the יסוד was a full square on all four sides, against רב.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear, as לוי taught: How do they build the altar? They bring a square frame, 32 by 32, one cubit high. He brings stones, large and small, and lime, lead and tar, melts them and pours. And this is the place of the base.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a stronger proof for לוי, from a ברייתא that לוי himself taught. The quote runs through step 16, and step 17 begins a response on רב's behalf that continues on the next amud.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The bottom layer is a full 32 by 32 square, one אמה high, and the ברייתא calls it 'the place of the יסוד'. That means the יסוד covered every side, including the south and east. This is hard for רב, who said part of it was never built.
steps.whyThisMatters: This is the strongest source so far for לוי, because it says outright that the full 32 by 32 bottom layer is the יסוד.

phrases.english: Come and hear, as לוי taught:
How do they build the altar?
They bring a square frame that is
thirty-two by thirty-two
and its height is one cubit,
and he brings damp smooth stones,
both large and small,
and he brings lime, lead, and tar,
and melts them and pours.
And this is the place of the base.

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּא שְׁמַע, דְּתָנֵי לֵוִי: כֵּיצַד בּוֹנִין אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A third proof for לוי, coming after רב's answers in steps 11 and 13.
steps.raayaObject: לוי's view that the יסוד existed on all four sides
steps.raayaSupportSource: ברייתא taught by לוי: the 32 by 32 bottom layer is 'the place of the יסוד'

steps.title: The middle layers of the altar get smaller as they go up
steps.stepSummary: לוי's ברייתא continues. A 30 by 30 frame, five אמות high, is built on top of the יסוד. Then a 28 by 28 frame, three אמות high, is built on top of that, and this is the place of the wood fire (מערכה).
steps.simpleTranslation: Next he brings a frame 30 by 30 אמות, 5 אמות high, and fills it with stones and the poured mixture. Next he brings a frame 28 by 28 אמות, 3 אמות high, and fills it the same way. That top surface is where the wood fire is arranged.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is still quoting the same ברייתא that לוי taught in step 14. It describes the next two layers of the מזבח, each one a bit smaller than the layer below it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each new frame steps in from the layer below it: 32, then 30, then 28. This shows the ברייתא is describing neat, full squares centered on each other, layer by layer. So the bottom 32 by 32 layer also sounds like a full square, with a יסוד on every side, which is what לוי says.

keyTerms.meaning: And then he goes back and brings: the next building step
Pieces of stone used to fill the frame
Etc.: the rest of the wording is the same as before
The place of the arrangement: the top surface where the wood fire burned

steps.confusionAlert: The numbers 30 and 28 are not the יסוד. They are the higher layers. The יסוד is only the bottom 32 by 32 layer from step 14.

phrases.english: And then he brings a square frame

phrases.aramaic: שֶׁהוּא שְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה עַל שְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה
phrases.english: which is thirty cubits by thirty cubits
and its height is five cubits,
and he brings pieces of stone, etc.
phrases.notes: The 'etc.' stands for the rest of the filling process from step 14: stones, then the melted mixture poured between them.

phrases.english: And then he brings a square frame

phrases.aramaic: שֶׁהוּא עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁמוֹנֶה עַל עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁמוֹנֶה אַמּוֹת
phrases.english: which is twenty-eight by twenty-eight cubits
and its height is three cubits,
and he brings pieces of stone, etc.
And this is the place of the arrangement of wood.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְחוֹזֵר וּמֵבִיא מַלְבֵּן שֶׁהוּא שְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה עַל שְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues quoting the same ברייתא of לוי begun in step 14
steps.raayaObject: לוי's view that the יסוד went around all four sides
steps.raayaSupportSource: לוי's ברייתא describing the altar as stacked, centered square frames

steps.title: The corners are built the same way on every corner
steps.stepSummary: The ברייתא finishes. A small one-by-one frame is filled with stones and the poured mixture to make a קרן (corner), and this is done for each of the four corners.
steps.simpleTranslation: Next he brings a frame one אמה by one אמה. He fills it with damp stones, big and small, then melts tar and lead and pours them in. That is a corner, and he does the same for every corner.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא describes the last step: building the four raised corners on top of the מזבח. With this, לוי's whole source has been quoted.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The whole ברייתא describes the מזבח as even, full squares, from the 32 by 32 bottom all the way up to the four corners. Nothing hints that the bottom layer was missing on any side. So the proof against רב, who holds the יסוד did not go around the whole מזבח, now stands fully presented.

keyTerms.meaning: A raised corner of the מזבח

steps.whatToRemember: לוי's ברייתא builds the מזבח as stacked squares: 32 (the יסוד), 30, 28, then four one-אמה corners. Read plainly, it shows a יסוד on all four sides, which is a challenge to רב.

phrases.english: And then he brings a square frame
which is one cubit by one cubit,
and he brings pieces of damp stone
both large and small,
and he brings tar and molten lead,
and melts them and pours.
And this is the corner.
And so for each and every corner.

steps.title: Opening a possible answer for רב's side
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא begins with 'וכי תימא' ('and if you would say'). It is starting to raise a possible way to read the ברייתא that would still fit רב.
steps.whatsHappening: This is a setup line. The גמרא is opening a suggestion for how רב's side might get around לוי's ברייתא, and the suggestion itself continues in the next part of the text.
steps.deeperAnalysis: 'וכי תימא' introduces a possible answer that the גמרא will look at closely. Often the גמרא raises this kind of answer only to show it does not work. We need to see the next line to know where it goes.
